pending: The 34 decades, each with Klebeblock A, B and C (start, end, days), Ruecktrittsfrist, Plakateingang and Motivanweisung.
The 52 calendar weeks in the same shape.

rules.klebeblock_b: Klebeblock B starts 3 days after Klebeblock A.
rules.klebeblock_c: Klebeblock C starts 7 days after Klebeblock A.

double_decades.note: Decades 01 and 34 are double decades; every other decade is the standard length.

rules.plakateingang: WORKDAY(start minus 1, minus 5) — five working days before the day preceding the start.
rules.wochenaushang: Weekly posting always begins on a Tuesday.

caveats.source: B|A|M Bundesverband Aussenmedien, stated on the calendar itself
items: No warranty is given for the dates.
Actual dates may differ by plus or minus one day.
Individual municipalities may operate special arrangements.
caveats.consequence: An agent may use these dates as a default. It may not present them as a commitment; a concrete date has to be confirmed by the lessee.
